$comment: The YACHATDAC palette. Read from the Figma local variable collection 'YACHATDAC Colour' in file 7XBvi0Mdbtmym10nkF9IGp on 2026-08-31, and cross-checked hex-for-hex against 'YACHATDAC Branding Guide (Initial).pdf'. Both agree. Keep the name/meaning pairing — every colour is tied to a real element of Country, and flattening these to primary/secondary/accent loses the point of them.
warning: Three colours in src/app/globals.css and src/content/kit.ts do NOT match this set — burnt #d97804, eucalyptus #3f6b1f ('Olive Grove'), oxide #c23d31 ('Rust Red').
